explication: Awesome LLM Apps is a catalog of independent, runnable AI applications rather than one deployed system. The recurring workflow is user input → validation or routing → model/tool orchestration → retrieval or generation → persisted or streamed result. Sampled applications cover RAG tutoring, database-routed question answering, model routing, migration planning, audio-tour research, podcast production, and MCP-powered generative UIs. Because the repository is heterogeneous and excerpts are partial, links are limited to directly evidenced calls and documented graph stages.
